name: web-travel-admin-panel-dashboard-with-bookings-chart
title: Travel Admin Dashboard with Bookings Chart
whatItIs: A lavender board with a torn-paper 'Dashboard Page' title above a light admin UI with four KPI cards, a monthly bookings bar chart with a highlighted July tooltip, a popular destination photo card and a recent bookings table.
whatItMeans: Soft blue charts with pastel KPIs and a photo card feel welcoming for an operations tool.
techniques: Bar chart with faded track bars behind the values
Photo card for destination breaking up the data
Coloured icon tiles on KPI cards
Sidebar with grouped sections and support card

vocabulary.definition: A faded bar behind a value bar showing the maximum.
A floating label marking a chart value.
Navigation items grouped under small headings.
